title: BLS12-381 recover-P: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS + Arch2-Prod-ZeroCopy-U32 + 1-Owner 4-Vec Arch B LA + NB(r=0.5/1.0, DISC=0.001) & [7e] Conditioning (expected work 2^108.964101409476)

claims.statement: Under declared exploratory STNFS heuristics H1/H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X, H5, the self-contained BLS12-381 recover-P algorithm under unified meter t_run = 2^123.0 u (expected opened run <= 2^110.3216 u, success >= 999338/1000000) behind the 64-bit gate K = 7198995924048445201 achieves overall success >= 0.39 with expected work < 2^108.964101409476 dense F_(p^12) units (C = 20,000).
